name.zh: 华为 Atlas 960 超节点（HC2025 路线图：15,488 NPU、220 柜）
name.en: Huawei Atlas 960 SuperPoD (HC2025 roadmap: 15,488 NPUs, 220 cabinets)

name.zh: 4 平面 × 两层，radix 1,024，每 NPU 4 个 scale-out 口（主算例）
name.en: 4 planes × 2 tiers, radix 1,024, 4 scale-out ports per NPU (main case)

basis.zh: 与 native950 / 960E 记录相同的假设：HC2026 的两层四平面 Clos，UBG 交换机 1,024 口
basis.en: the same assumption as the native950 / 960E records: HC2026 two-tier four-plane Clos, UBG switches of 1,024 ports

superpod.source: Huawei Connect 2025 keynote (2025-09-18): Atlas 960 SuperPoD, 15,488 NPUs in 220 cabinets, 2027 Q4 roadmap; HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 (2026-09-17) revised the 960 SuperPoD to 4,096 NPUs (the a960e record) — this record keeps the HC2025 figure as a roadmap case
superpod.note: roadmap announcement, not a build; the two public numbers are the NPU count and the cabinet count

superpod.computeRacks.source: assumed: the 220 cabinets split 4 : 1 into compute and UB interconnect cabinets, as the Atlas 950 (16 + 4) and Atlas 960E (56 + 14) SuperPoDs

superpod.commRacks.source: assumed: the 220 cabinets split 4 : 1 into compute and UB interconnect cabinets, as the Atlas 950 (16 + 4) and Atlas 960E (56 + 14) SuperPoDs

superpod.nodesPerRack.source: assumed: 15,488 NPUs ÷ 176 compute cabinets = 88 NPUs per cabinet = 11 trays × 8 NPUs

superpod.fabric.source: assumed: the Atlas 950 cabinet-mesh + optical-Clos form (UB 2.x successor): 72 in-cabinet UB switches, 2 × 800G uplinks per NPU, 128-port pod switches

superpod.rackSwitches.source: assumed: as the Atlas 950 cabinet (UB-Mesh paper reference cabinet)

superpod.podUplinksPerNpu.source: assumed: as the Atlas 950 (2 × 800G per NPU)

superpod.cpusPerNode.source: assumed: 2 Kunpeng per 8-NPU tray, as the Atlas 950 / 960E records

scaleOut.source: assumed: as the native950 / a960e records — HC2026 two-tier four-plane Clos, 1,024-port UBG switches, 4 ports per NPU

assumed.en: 220 cabinets split 4 : 1 into 176 compute + 44 UB cabinets (Atlas 950 16 + 4, 960E 56 + 14)

assumed.zh: 每计算柜 88 NPU = 11 托盘 × 8（15,488 ÷ 176），每托盘 2 颗鲲鹏
assumed.en: 88 NPUs per compute cabinet = 11 trays × 8 (15,488 ÷ 176), 2 Kunpeng per tray

assumed.zh: 柜内全互联 + 光交换 Clos 的 Atlas 950 形态：每柜 72 片 UB 交换、每 NPU 2 × 800G 上联、128 口超节点层交换机
assumed.en: the Atlas 950 cabinet-mesh + optical-Clos form: 72 UB switches per cabinet, 2 × 800G uplinks per NPU, 128-port pod-tier switches

assumed.zh: 超节点之间 4 平面 × 两层 Clos、radix 1,024、每 NPU 4 口（与 native950 / 960E 记录相同）
assumed.en: between SuperPoDs 4 planes × 2 tiers, radix 1,024, 4 ports per NPU (as the native950 / 960E records)

assumed.zh: HC2026 已把 960 超节点改为 4,096 NPU（a960e 记录）；本记录保留 HC2025 的 15,488 卡路线图数字作为对照
assumed.en: HC2026 revised the 960 SuperPoD to 4,096 NPUs (the a960e record); this record keeps the HC2025 15,488-NPU roadmap figure as a comparison case

ubLabel.zh: UB 交换（柜内 + 互联柜）+ 光链路（假设形态）
ubLabel.en: UB switching (in-cabinet + UB cabinets) + optics (assumed form)

podLabel.zh: 超节点 15,488 NPU：176 计算柜 + 44 互联柜（路线图）
